text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—A fundamental question. "What is the 
Twinkle Series?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Many would answer like this: That it is a 
"sport."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, that's a generalization based 
purely on superficial observation. It can 
hardly be called grasping the essence of 
the matter.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: If you ask me, the Twinkle Series is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's a "game."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume's abilities, and their 
initial setup. The limited turns remaining 
until the target race, planning the route 
of progression...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Then success in the Series cannot be 
measured solely by effort and guts. Yes, 
the most important thing is—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's "strategy"!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Muscle-brained victories aren't 
reproducible. Only flexible strategies 
make breakthroughs possible.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Through strategy alone, I shall 
demonstrate my dominion over this Twinkle 
Series."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Dance, go ahead and dance, my pawns. Right 
in the palm of my hand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Hahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Kh, damn it... Is it already time to go to 
training...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, what a drag... I don't wanna go 
out... I just wanna play board games all 
day today...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll talk to my Trainer and ask for 
the day off~. They're an unrivaled board 
game fanatic too, so I'm sure they'll 
understand...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Geh, they came to pick me up!?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped... Guess I'll go. It's not 
like I can just ignore it~

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I worked hard training with 
Rulership once again. I became her Trainer 
not just because I was drawn to her 
running, but...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Trainer. The 
expansion pack for that game arrived.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wanna do it once training is over?
choice_data_list: Of course! Today's the day we win!

Of course! We're definitely going to win 
today!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Will it really go that smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh, my win. You did a good job grasping 
the quirks of the new environment in your 
own way, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
If you don't grasp the game designer's 
true intent, your response will always be 
half a step too late. Only by doing so can 
you truly be a "Grandmaster of the Board."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The main reason I became her Trainer was 
because I was captivated by her 
overwhelming intellect.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, Rulership and I were 
acquaintances from an online game, and 
I've held them in high regard since back 
then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her talent for strategic planning wasn't 
limited to board games...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, the next mock race... With this many 
participants――

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We'll need a bypass strategy to handle 
dense pack formations. Trainer, I'd like 
our menu centered around that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her strategic mind is fully displayed in 
races as well. My role is to support that, 
and...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyy? How did I lose? Stop making 
unpredictable moves!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, what a trash game, seriously 
stupid... Does this kind of thing happen 
in the actual Twinkle Series toooo?
choice_data_list:
D-don't worry... You just had terrible 
luck this time

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To act as a comforter when things didn't 
go well. Being so full of confidence, the 
drop after a failure was severe, but...
choice_data_list:
It's okay, we can definitely use that 
strategy in the future!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I see. If you say so, I suppose 
I'll just chalk this one up to bad luck.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As long as the strategy is sound, 
probability will converge. With the 
ultimate strategy, we'll pull off an 
astonishing win rate—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I will become it! I will show you that I 
can— the ruler of the Twinkle Series. 
Hahaha...!"
Hmm, high morale is always a good thing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Y-You've shown yourself! Air 
Groove-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Don't talk about people like they're 
some kind of monster. I heard you've 
officially been set to debut in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Air Groove. She's the 
student council vice president known as 
"The Empress," but before that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even if I try not to care, I just can't 
help keeping my eyes on you. And that's 
because—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's one of the Umamusume whose growth 
I've watched since she was a little kid, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, please stop. Looking at me like a 
guardian, I mean...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An elite academy for Umamusume founded by 
Air Groove's mother. Both Air Groove and 
Rulership were students there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Air Groove has been looking out 
for Rulership ever since back then. In a 
manner of speaking—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Senior disciple and junior disciple. That 
bond continues even after coming to Tracen 
Academy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your talent is... impeccable. And yet, you 
rarely leave your room...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Always obsessing over crafting 
strategies... Her extremely inward-looking 
attitude is... honestly, hard for me to 
understand.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't one simply approach daily 
training with dedication? Why turn racing 
into a game?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... That goes without saying. After 
all, it is *me* we are talking about.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Tackling things like Air Groove-san 
does... is straight-up impossible.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You, and that other beloved disciple 
you've been doting on lately, Admire 
Groove, as well..."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"You guys are athletes to the bone. Your 
fundamental nature is completely different 
from mine."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"If you're swordsmen, then I'm a 
tactician. I won't be winning fair and 
square with swordplay—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Making full use of tactics, her creed is 
to dominate the field just like a board 
game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the kind of race I want to 
run with this Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... I only hope that's not just an 
excuse for being a homebody. If that's the 
case—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Prove it with real results. If you cannot 
demonstrate it yourself, it is nothing 
more than fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer. Let her give 
it her all with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let me know if she's reluctant to leave 
her room. I can drag her out by the scruff 
of her neck whenever you need.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't. Just treat us like an idle 
game and leave us alone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Air Groove walked away—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer. It's finally time to 
kick off the campaign.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
From now on, we enter an era where victory 
is decided not by sweat, but by strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let us advance our pieces, Trainer. And 
then—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I will conquer—this board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—the opening gun sounded. This is a 
game. But it is no fantasy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The game board we aim to dominate, the 
Twinkle Series, is— without a doubt, right 
before our eyes.
